row.body: The bottle is beside a delivery note that asks the next shift to keep the back room ventilated after the test. The food order is still unpaid.
row.title: The bottle left open

sidecar.gloss: A test and a ventilation request interrupt a routine food order.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have ventilated a room after cleaning or exposure; the note does not say what the test involved.
